rubrics.justification: Uses the provided poor-grade assessment appropriately but misinterprets Gardner 0 as no blastocoel/pre-blastocyst and calls the embryo a morula; this is inconsistent with the stated lab designation of early blastocyst/very poor blastocyst and includes features not clearly supportable from the image alone.

Good integration of age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, prior failed cycles, endometrial thickness, and semen parameters with embryo prognosis, though some links (e.g. endometriosis causing higher aneuploidy) are stated too strongly.

Overall logic is clear: very poor embryo morphology plus repeated failed cycles and endometriosis imply low implantation potential. Minor issues include overcalling RIF and some overinterpretation of causality.

Contains several non-guideline-supported or controversial recommendations presented too strongly (ERA, NK cell testing, intralipids, routine immunologic workup, TESE/PICSI based only on possible SDF). PGT-A and endometriosis suppression may be considered but are not universally indicated as framed.

Provides clear counseling and future-cycle suggestions, including expectation setting and additional workup options. However, some recommendations are overly aggressive or insufficiently evidence-qualified.
